response.sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals), store_rentals AS (SELECT i.store_id, rt.total FROM rental_totals rt JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = rt.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id) SELECT sr.store_id, SUM(sr.total) AS total_payments, AVG(sr.total - a.avg_total) AS avg_above_average FROM store_rentals sr CROSS JOIN avg_total a WHERE sr.total > a.avg_total GROUP BY sr.store_id ORDER BY sr.store_id;
